display_long_description:
From the creator of Cubism comes **LASER DANCE**, a mixed reality game that turns your living room into a laser obstacle course straight from a spy film!

[media]

# Play in any room

Players move between two buttons on opposite ends of their living room, traversing a sequence of laser patterns which adapt to the room’s size and layout. Different laser patterns will have them move in different ways, as they dance, dodge, and crawl their way to the finish line.

[media]

# Easy to learn, hard to master

Laser Dance’s deceptively simple gameplay makes for a perfect party game to get both newcomers and seasoned VR players moving in mixed reality!

[media]

# Early Access features:
- 🕺 24 levels containing 118 unique laser patterns
- ↔️ Levels adapt to your living room size and layout
- 👴 Levels adapt to your level of mobility with accessibility settings
- 🏆 Unlockable challenges that will have you playing old levels in new ways
- ✨ And more to come during Early Access!

[media]

# [NEW] The Anniversary Update 
To mark Laser Dance's 1 year anniversary, this small update adds a new stats screen, showing fun facts about your progress in the game!

[media]

# FAQ
**Do I need a big room?**

Laser Dance is played between two buttons on your walls. As long as the shortest path between them is about 3m (~10ft) you're good to go!

**How is my body tracked?**

Laser Dance supports Quest's inside-out upper body tracking - meaning head, hands, arms and spine are tracked. Legs are not tracked.

**Where can I get help with a technical issue?**

www.LaserDanceGame.com/help
